div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 企业视频自动化生成需求进入架构评审

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 视频是否包含必须 100% 精确的业务数字、财务折线图、代码或动态客户姓名?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 100% 采用 AI 视频生成大模型 (Sora 2 / Veo 3 / Runway Gen-4 / Kling)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 画面是否同时需要电影级写实人物/实景风光背景?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 采用“AI 无字写实 B-Roll 底片 + BiRefNet 景深穿插 + Remotion/D3 数据层”混合架构 ($0.042/条)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 核心逻辑是“按步骤因果状态机演进”还是“JSON 数据模板高并发裂变”?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 选用 Motion Canvas (TypeScript Generator 协程精确控时)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 选用 Remotion (React 函数式分片 + Serverless Lambda 并发渲染)
